book.name: LOMU
book.title: Lomu wewenasida luhuwa maya Polokaho je biye

content: Luka lupaya Omaimidanago metune.

Sa-onenako, wewenanele yuhase, Omailimo obohala lemoko eke loletokaka noibokumuya aku dilipe momoga oko ga maya lo libituyo, elilo: Upa ukatipoya Omaimidanago mikadeko, Omaitoka jokila hi mikaka nesakidana eto iki minadeko. Omaimoya umu helitiye. Sa-ikiki Omaida mulutipo obohatipo miki lipi mitae.

Sa-ikiki iki moliki itabo nesaya monoka elamiki minabo wewenasida monawanipoloya demesalo molamilo. Sa-idekoya Omailimo edimodaya dilipe wili jekadeko aitomidana iki elewole depa mutiwa liki minatae. Sa-ikiki Omailimo letibotoka molatibotoka iki lalo nesa ito umu helitibo nesa ito wehe letibo nesago li soto molatae.

Omailimoya nasahili le ohenetaibokumuye loko muki wewenasidaya sa-loko lo noliboyo, elilo: Edimotipodamu data eliki wehe letibotogoya emesalo moliki minalo. Sa-ikiki yamidana asitiki mupilaloka yowetudawone liki lamiki moletiki Omailimo monoka le ohelibetaibotoka monawatipoya makoko aweyahalo moli elilo.
Lemo lupateya makoko neboya, elekele nesalaya wavu-liki miniki aito aito elekele yowanula litikaka niae.
Ayamidana oko muki wewenaya Kalaestitoka koludawolimoya nala makoko lolo oko minune. Sa-udanaki lemo elekele nobetuniyoko, edimo elekele nilitayoko oko minune.

Omailimoya yowanu lekaka nesala nasahilila aito-aitomidana oko le oheletokaiyoko, lemoya monoka lokakamidana elewoleya aito-aitomidana le-minune. Sa-onenako, lemenebomidana makoko aweyaha oko yowanuya lekaka noune. Sa-onenako, wewena makolimoya Omaimidana epalauti ga lo soto molatiboya, eimolatoka Omaimidanamuya elewole oko elitibomidana abuha-wowoya netibomidana makoko aweyaha oko lo soto molakolaiye.

Wewena makolimoya elekele obetuwe loko maya abuhalalimo letiboto makoko aweyaha oko sa-ekolaiye. Ito wewena makolimoya ga api-napi okaka yowanu lituwe loko maya, eimola abuhalalimo letiboto makoko aweyaha oko lekolaiye.

Wewena makolimoya data lekaka yowanuya lituwe loko maya, eimola abuhalalimo letiboto makoko aweyaha oko lekolaiye. Wewena makolimoya Omaimidana yowanulalo ehada hulatuwe loko letibo maya, eimola mulunau lalo eleko wavu-leko hulakolaiye. Wewena makolimoya monoka ujapa we minatuwe lokoma eimola abuha moloko ujapa etiye. Wewena makolimoya milumanipo elituwe loko maya, elowa jeko milumanipo eleko nasahili obetakolaiye. 4 1 Kol 12:12 6 1 Kol 12:4-11
Ohatama weute moloko oko moloko etudawo ga.
Maloka wewenasida duka biki nasahili ikaka niabo nesaya dupalotigoya samiki lahelametibo nesa maya mudai huliki omusepatipo yowideko, mudai hulikiki lalo nesa maya li pilikiki li-minalo.
Iwetipolekiya emo uka mideko emo uka mideko iki dabuha moliki dulinipo li sawa jitabomugoya elilo.
Monoka yowanu letune liki maya, osele-pasele amiki dabuha moliki minalo. We napamidana elekelela itiki dukauya monokalimo waitideko minalo.
Omailokatiya lalo nesa letune liki ubolo minabomidana elowa jiki ewa iki minalo. Sakikiya miluma nesamidana epau miniki maya, hulu iki miniki Omailoka domuda likiki elewole ikigo minalo.
Jisesida wewenalalesiya sainamu ohu nijidekoma, aya nesa maya bilo. Wenoka wewena ninisideko maya, dilipi numudatipou moliki dilipi lalo nesa ibitalo.
Lahelametibo nesa lolo nilibitatabo wewenasida maya Omailoka lideko dilipe lalo nesa obetadeyo. Lahelametibo nesa lolo obetatiye liki lamiki dilipe lalo nesa oko maku bitiye liki lilo.
Mulunipou lalo elitabo wewenakiya magoina mulutipouya lalo elideyo. Wije nama liki miluma nielitabo wewenamakiya magoina mulutipouya lalo elamideyo.
Sa-ikiki duka moli makokoto ikiki makoko data kiki minalo. Edimotipomuya elideko yowamideko, limiki miniki yowanu lilo. Edimotipodamuya muki nesa monawa ele-minune liki lamilo.
Lahelametibo nesa lolo ilibitatabo maya, edimolikaya aku dade lihima liki lolo ibitamilo. Wewenasi elideko wehe letibo nesago lolo ilo.
Yamidana anuwa mako soto pideko ito edimo nesatipo lolo ideyamaya, muki numuto namato wewenakiya ouna jiki minalo.
Iwenelita, lihimatipoya edimotipo pasamilo. Omailimoya alika niseko mesaha jebetatibo onawalomugoya ujapa iki minalo. Yamuya monoka bukuguya ga mako sa-liki luhuwa ji-minabo maya ne:

content.text: We napalimoya lihima pasokaka yowanuya neimone yowanune nenako, alikaya niseko litubo ne, loko lone.

content: Monoka bukuguya ga mako sa-liki luhuwa ji-minabo maya neyoko, sakigoya minalo:

content.text: Ulatipolo we maya nodekumu helikadeko maya, nodenesa biki nalo. Nomu deladeko maya, noya hiki biki nalo. Sa-itaboya, edimoda lahelamibo nesa lolo ilibitabomuya owanipo luwideko, mulunipouya miluma napa elitabo neyo.

content: Aya ga maya elikiki, lahelamibo nesalimoya alikaya dilipe-loko lemamideyo.
Sakoya minamiye, edimoya lalo nesamagoya lolo niki lahelametibo nesamidana maya asitalo. 14 Mat 5:44; Luk 6:28 16 Plo 3:7 19 Dut 32:35 20 Plo 25:21-22
